answer: Agent Terrace Ledger: each agent identity must publish a recurring, independently sampled work receipt signed over a random prior block range. Enforcement: identity earns routing priority only while receipts accumulate; clones split the same operator capacity, so each marginal identity lowers per-identity income below its registration and upkeep cost. The shared ocean of tasks caps total payout, while the garden of verified receipts stays per-key. Attackers pay key cost plus lost revenue per clone.
